_about: DIAGNOSTIC: task_h.json for the bare duchamp3 table (no riser, docs/REAL_RIG_GAPS.md gap 9). The policies were trained with the tabletop at model z = 0; the real one is ~30 mm lower. Safety clearances count from the measured table and the handoff point moves down with it, so a run shows where the trained policies fail. Not for production runs. Task H real-arm runner (deploy/runner.py). Lengths m, angles rad, times s. Values copied from the sim must match it: deploy/checks/conventions.py checks them.

act._start: PickEnv ready pose, model frame (tcp 18 cm above the reader area, top-down); the sim starts within +-0.08 rad of it
act._max_step: cap on each ACT target change per tick; demo targets change <= 0.048 rad per tick

_start_envelope: data/task_h/ready_settle_001.json (2026-10-28): rest -> ready with move_to(settle_trim=True), all joints within 3.3 mrad, held 2 s with the trim and 1 s without; the runner still refuses a ready pose missed by > 0.02 rad on every run

handoff._p_nom: nominal pre-insert tcp for the configured PC pose (handoff.nominal_preinsert): the PC must stand where scene/pc_bench.py puts it
handoff._p_nom_bare_table: z lowered by -0.028 m with the table (the port stands on it)

release_trigger._why: handoff.ReleaseTrigger: no proprio seat signal works for this policy (FINDINGS 2026-10-28)

gripper._map: i2rt 0 closed .. 1 open. finger opening (m) linear through (open, m_open) and (g_reader, m_reader) once measured (checks/gripper_cal.py); close = squeeze target
gripper._gate: deploy/grasp.reader_present, encoder units. data/task_h/grasp_gate_001.json (2026-10-28, 3 reps): empty 0.015, reader 0.249-0.257, all verdicts right. Calibration session (gripper_cal_20261027.json): empty 0.038, reader 0.337. i2rt re-calibrates the gripper on each connect, so the scale moves between sessions; this band (0.134-0.373) classifies both sessions. Squeeze force not measured.

safety._clearances: FlexChecker, model frame, m above the table, on targets and measured poses. Dry run (sim, true joints): fingertips reach -0.6 mm (contact), but ACT's grasp targets put them down to -9 mm (the PD error presses the fingers on the table); gripper body >= 51 mm, link_6 >= 55 mm
safety._table_z: measured -28/-34/-30 mm (table_probe_002); -28 = the shallowest, so the clearances are not looser than designed

scene._about: where to put things, right arm base frame (table top z = 0, +x forward, +y toward the left arm); pc_bench.py
scene.trained_ranges: port +-2 cm x, +-4 cm y, PC yaw +-10 deg; reader +-3 cm x, +-5 cm y, yaw +-20 deg
